title: DiscoveryCurve
description: How each observable responds to the swept item, from the per-step effects (docs/adr/0032-sensitivity-discovery-sweeps.md). A classification per observable, never a decision: there is no control of multiplicity across observables.

unit.description: Unit of the metric, read from its name (s, deg, m, km/h, g, mm, ...); empty when unknown.

shape.title: CurveShape
shape.description: negligible: every step inside the margin (two one-sided tests at each step). direction_change: one stretch of the curve rises and another falls, both clear of zero. nonlinear: the quadratic term of the weighted fit through the baseline is clear of zero. linear: the slope is clear of zero and the quadratic term is not. insufficient: fewer than two steps, or nothing clear.

clicks.description: The steps the classification used, in clicks from the baseline, ascending.

turn_clicks.description: For a direction change: the step (or 0, the baseline) at which the response turns.

CurveEstimate.title: CurveEstimate
CurveEstimate.description: A coefficient of the weighted fit through the baseline, with its interval at the classification's level. slope: per click (straight line). curvature: per click squared (the quadratic term).
